purpose: Fix for the class-collapse found in ../RESULTS.md: condition on (direction, digit) and reward the requested digit, so collapsing onto one class lowers reward. Declared before training.

pretrain.dropout: direction and digit each dropped independently with p=0.1 (CFG)

reward_train: guard(0.02<=ink<=0.30 every frame) * [0.4 * mean_t proxy_p(requested digit) + 0.6 * max(0,cos(centroid displacement, requested direction)) * speed_match]
reward_changes_vs_first_study: requested-digit probability replaces max-class confidence x consistency
ink guard widened from 0.15 to 0.30 (the first guard rejected 28% of pretrained frames)

grpo.note: identical hyperparameters to the first study; final weights evaluated, no early stopping

evaluation.layout: clip i -> direction i%8, digit (i//8)%10; 4 clips per (direction,digit)
evaluation.primary: success = evaluator mode digit == requested AND conf>=0.7 AND consistency>=0.75 AND phase-corr angle error < 22.5 deg
evaluation.uncertainty: paired clip bootstrap 95% CI, per seed and pooled

amendment_1.reason: attempt 1 failed the gate: correct digit 5% (CFG 3: 14%); digit embedding norm 0.53 vs direction 33 - zero-init embedding received too little signal under warm start. Record in runs_attempt1_gate_failed/.
amendment_1.change: digit embedding learning rate 1e-2 (50x), rest 2e-4; 3000 steps; early check at step 1000

amendment_2.reason: attempt 2 (warm start, digit-embedding lr 1e-2) at step 1000: correct digit 6.25%, embedding norm 0.99; warm start ignores digit. Record in runs_attempt2_warmstart_failed/.
amendment_2.change: train the (direction, digit) model from scratch, same recipe as the direction model: 8000 steps, lr 2e-4, EMA 0.999, independent 10% dropout of each label

amendment_3.reason: gate at 8000 steps: correct digit 36.25% < 40% (rising: 6% @2500, 21% @5000); gate unchanged
amendment_3.change: continue the same run (constant lr after warmup) from the step-8000 checkpoint to 12000 steps, then re-run the identical gate
